extraction: Comprehensive Guide to Ollama (n1n.ai): Landscape shifted from cloud data centers to local machines. Ollama for local development, prototyping, privacy-first workflows. n1n.ai provides stable high-speed API for production scaling. Why Local LLMs: 1) Privacy/Security - proprietary code/docs never leave local environment (enterprise compliance), 2) Zero Inference Costs - infinite tokens after download, 3) Offline Development - functional on flights/secure facilities, 4) Low Latency - limited only by hardware compute. Hybrid approach: local Ollama for testing + unified API (n1n.ai) for production = industry gold standard.
